text:
maria-sec: Auditor NM asked for a compact SOC2 evidence packet: RBAC change for `svc-embedder`, the deployment and authz logs showing the transition, KMS usage metadata (no plaintext), and a checksum + signed manifest. need by EOD.

tyler-dev: OK. PR merged at 2026-03-20T11:40Z — do they want PR+6h or PR+24h?

maria-sec: PR+6h per their scope. include the PR link, the kube deploy job logs, and the canary timeline. keep it minimal.

oncall-bot: note: API gateway traces retained 60 days; debug payloads sampled. recommend exact-window export to S3 and provide sha256 per object.

tyler-dev: kicking export. @ops-bot export k8s-audit, authz-decisions, api-gateway logs and CloudTrail KMS events for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/embed-key from 2026-03-20T11:40:00Z to 2026-03-20T17:40:00Z to s3://redwood-audit/7800033333-evidence/. include request ids.

ops-bot: export started job-id exp-7800033333-01 ETA ~5m. will post presigned URL and sha256. :white_check_mark:

maria-sec: auditor wants per-file sha256 and an HMAC-signed manifest from SOC. include a short chain-of-custody note and the internal evidence tag.

auditor_nm: accepted artifacts: 1) PR diff + git link, 2) logs showing RBAC eval changed to allow svc-embedder, 3) CloudTrail entries for Encrypt/GenerateDataKey/Decrypt with keyId, 4) object hashes + signature. hashes ok.

tyler-dev: RBAC diff snippet: 
```diff
- rolebinding embedder-reader -> group: embedder-viewers
+ rolebinding embedder-reader -> group: embedder-operators
+ rules:
+ - apiGroups: ["" ]
+   resources: ["secrets"]
+   verbs: ["get"]
+   resourceNames: ["model-keys"]
```

ops-bot: export ready: https://s3-presigned.redwood/audit/7800033333-evidence.tar.gz?sig=ZZZ (expires in 7d) sha256=9f2a...b7c3

maria-sec: manifest signed: MANIFEST_SHA256=9f2a...b7c3 SIG_MANIFEST=MEUCID... signed-by=maria-sec. evidence id EVID-20260320-7800033333. chain-of-custody note attached.

auditor_nm: quick Q: do you have anomaly detection for this KMS key (high-rate Decrypt/GenerateDataKey)? want to see alert history for the window.

maria-sec: yes. detection rule KMS-OP-RATE-ALERT-v3 forwards to PagerDuty. no firings in the requested window; will include rule definition and last 30d firing log (none during window).

auditor_nm: good. final minor ask: include a pointer to the RBAC rollback runbook and a one-line summary of rollback time.

tyler-dev: runbook: https://confluence.redwood/release-runbooks/rbac-rollback snapshot attached. rollback via kubectl apply -f rolebinding-prev.yaml, traffic cutover ~2m in canary.

maria-sec: sending secure link + manifest to auditor_nm now. if they need raw CloudTrail we can escalate under NDA.

auditor_nm: bundle received and hash verified. may ping for a short follow-up but this is sufficient for now. thanks for the quick turn.
